notes: Seven web searches ran; none was refused. Results for Neguse and AI were thin, so the search may be incomplete. AI mentions found on neguse.house.gov were incidental and mostly before 2025 (research funding requests citing AI among priority areas, a 2023 Colorado delegation tech hubs letter, Congressional App Challenge winners, CU Boulder NCWIT funding); none is a statement about AI risk. His committee page lists a seat on the House Judiciary Subcommittee on Courts, Intellectual Property, Artificial Intelligence, and the Internet (https://neguse.house.gov/about/committees-and-caucuses, not opened). A Denver Gazette op-ed ('Perspective: Colorado's AI Crossroads') names him in passing with no stated position (not opened). Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026): the fastdemocracy.com cosponsor list (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/us/119/bills/USB00108512/, opened) does not include Neguse; Congress.gov was not checked directly. No House letter about AI risk signed or led by him was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions). Only the first page (10 of 131 pages, September to November 2026) of his press releases was checked directly; it had no AI-related releases.
